in_marathi.name: Ayati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ayati is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘āyatī’ which means ‘one who brings joy to the mother’. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Durga is known to bring joy to her devotees, making the name Ayati an apt choice for a baby girl.
